fusions.name: Lifted Purse
fusions.desc: Casts a hooked link at the first enemy it meets that deals 9 damage. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, and leaves the target [Damped] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Crossed Wires
fusions.desc: Snaps a ring of links around you that deals 10 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocks each back 2 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave each [Marked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Slipped Leash
fusions.desc: Turns afflictions back on whoever inflicts them: each debuff laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to its source instead, for 9 seconds.

fusions.name: Tangled Feint
fusions.desc: Against an enemy that carries one of your afflictions, your chance to dodge rises by 10%.
